title: NLTK: Uncontrolled recursion in Tree.fromlist causes denial of service via deeply nested list input (CVE-2026-129227)
description: NLTK's Tree.fromlist method recursively converts nested lists into Tree objects without limiting recursion depth, unlike Tree.fromstring which enforces a MAX_TREE_DEPTH limit. This lack of depth checking allows an attacker to cause a denial of service by providing deeply nested list input, triggering an unhandled RecursionError. The issue affects versions prior to 3.10.4 and is fixed in 3.10.4.
